As per allegation, the marriage between the petitioner and the complainant was solemnized in the year of 2018 as per Hindu Rites and Customs and after the marriage, additional demand of dowry started and on account of non- fulfillment of the same, she was subjected to cruelty and ultimately ousted from the matrimonial home.
